data.heading: Week 2 (02 Jan - 08 Jan 2026):
data.text:
-  Minimum  temperatures  are  likely  to  be  below  normal  2-4°C  over  in  many  parts  of  east central India and Peninsular India except northeast India & Western Himalayan Region and many parts of northwest India, where these are likely to be above normal by 1-3°C during the week.
